subject: On-prem demo for regulated workloads — preflight & ops checklist
messages:
From: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@medgov.org>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Erickson <tom.erickson@medgov.org>
Date: 2027-04-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: On-prem demo for regulated workloads / compliance preflight

Hi Mina,

We signed up via the self-service flow and have an internal intake that suggests Redwood could meet our on-prem requirements for regulated workloads. I'd like to schedule a demo focused on the private/VPC/on-prem package with a heavy emphasis on compliance controls (KMS/HSM, audit logs, evidence for SOC2/PHI handling), and the operational preflight (networking, certs, installer details).

Attendees: myself (IT lead), Tom Erickson (security/compliance), and our procurement lead (TBD).

Can you propose a few 45–60 minute slots next week? Ideally we'd see: 1) a short architecture overview, 2) an ops preflight checklist, and 3) a demo of the control plane and audit logs. Also: do you have a compliance questionnaire we can start filling out, and any sample on-prem network diagram?

Thanks,
Sarah Lin
Director of IT — MedGov Health
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0199

Attachment: none
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>

Date: 2027-04-05T11:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: On-prem demo for regulated workloads / compliance preflight

Hi Sarah — great to hear from you, and congrats on getting through self-serve. Happy to run the demo and make it compliance-heavy. Suggested plan: 45-minute technical + compliance preflight, followed by a 15-minute Q&A.

We typically cover:
- High-level architecture and deployment modes (VPC, air-gapped installer)
- KMS/HSM integrations and key lifecycle
- Audit logs, S3/equivalent retention, and access controls
- Installer/network preflight (egress rules, ports, cert expectations)

Prereqs we ask teams to have on hand for the preflight:
- A technical contact with admin access to the environment (for network questions)
- Any existing security questionnaire or a list of required evidence (SOC2, ISO, HIPAA addenda)

I can offer these slots (all PDT):
- Tue 2027-04-06 10:00–11:00
- Wed 2027-04-07 14:00–15:00

If neither works we can open other times. I've included a Calendly link to make it easy: https://calendly.com/redwood/onprem-demo

I'll loop in our solutions engineer to prepare a short ops preflight checklist and a sample network diagram.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.com | (650) 555-0123

Subject: Re: Redwood — on-prem demo materials and proposed agenda

Thanks — 4/7 at 14:00 PDT works best for us. Please move the meeting to that slot and include Tom (cc'd) from our security team and our procurement lead once they're identified.

A couple of items to prep on your side:
- We need a concise statement of support for integrating customer-managed KMS (key wrap, HSM options). Can you bring or link to the integration guide?
- We also need a short data flow diagram that shows how PHI (pseudonymized in our PoC) would traverse the on-prem installation, where logs are captured, and what leaves the environment (if anything). The sample diagram you attached is useful — if you can show it during the call that would help.
- For procurement: can you confirm the licensing model for Private (per-GPU commit vs. node-based) and whether there are minimum terms? A summary slide would be helpful.

Tom will prepare a short list of evidence items from our side; we'll start filling out the workbook you attached.

Appreciate it — see you Thu 4/7 14:00 PDT.

Best,
Sarah Lin
